summary: The exact candidate replaces timing-sensitive per-rank equal-share guards with a host-local lock held across a fresh available-memory check and allocation at all host-pool sites. Independent tests reproduced the base failure and verified equal, unequal, and separate-job accounting boundaries.

tests.command: base mocked sequential host_memory_budget_bytes readings (100 then 60 GiB, four ranks)
tests.what_was_measured: 22.5 GiB initial and 12.5 GiB late budget; a late 20 GiB request is rejected although 4x20 GiB fits the initial 90 GiB usable total
real spawned processes admitted unequal 30+20+20+20 GiB requests and rejected one of two concurrent 60 GiB jobs against 90 GiB usable
35 tests passed and 12 subtests passed using the exact candidate source checkout

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was visible, but the issue and executed regressions concern CPU host-memory accounting and OS file locking.

remaining_limitations: Exact 8xH200 GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 serving reproduction and model weights were unavailable.
No multi-node or real heterogeneous-pipeline serving run was performed.
Separate jobs must share the same temporary-directory lock path; isolated container /tmp mounts and non-cooperating allocators are outside the coordination domain.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
